content.short: Ritual is a decentralized AI network that enables smart contracts to access and execute AI models trustlessly.
content.description:
Ritual is a pioneering decentralized AI infrastructure network designed to bridge the gap between artificial intelligence and blockchain technology. The platform features Infernet, a sophisticated AI oracle that allows smart contracts to trustlessly call any AI model for on-chain execution. This enables a wide variety of new use cases, from automated DeFi strategies to dynamic NFT generation, all secured by cryptographic proofs. Ritual acts as a foundational layer for the next generation of intelligent decentralized applications, often referred to as "AI-Fi."

In addition to its oracle capabilities, Ritual is developing its own custom execution layer designed specifically for AI-native operations and verifiable compute. The network aims to democratize access to high-performance AI models by providing a transparent and permissionless framework for developers and researchers. Through its commitment to verifiable privacy and decentralized compute, Ritual is building the essential infrastructure for a more intelligent and secure digital economy, where AI is a globally accessible and verifiable utility.
content.meta: Ritual provides a decentralized AI network and Infernet oracle for trustless AI-to-blockchain integration.
